content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 (auth missing at service); the payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer, so those routes are foreclosed, and resubmitting or correcting data won't cure a missing auth. Since a denial is on the table and documentation quality is reasonably strong (0.85), a formal appeal arguing medical necessity is the only legitimate path to collect the allowed amount, and there is ample time left in the 180-day filing window. Billing the patient for a provider-side authorization failure would exceed the contractual patient share, and writing off forfeits collectible revenue.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
